title: Okok, akadályok és a honvágy (Reasons for Migration, Obstacles & Homesickness)
grammar: Causal & Concessive Postpositions, Identity Correlatives & Narrative Participles in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say why people leave, with miatt and következtében.
I can talk about leaving a country with kivándorlás, áttelepülés, megélhetés and honvágy.
I can say that something happened in spite of an obstacle, with ellenére and dacára.
